# Ivan Cruz Portfolio

> Full Stack Web Developer specializing in React, TypeScript, Cloud Computing and DevOps.

## Sections

The whole portfolio lives on a single scrolling page:

- [Home](/) - Hero, about, skills, experience, projects, education and contact.
- [Español](/es) - Versión en español de la misma página.
- [Privacy](/privacy) - Privacy policy.
- [Terms](/terms) - Terms and conditions.

## Technical Details

- **Stack**: React 19, Vite, Tailwind CSS 4, TypeScript.
- **i18n**: Paraglide JS with English at the root and Spanish under `/es`.
- **Goals**: Creating high-performance, accessible, and aesthetically pleasing web experiences.
